title: SPEC 12 Phase 4 and w1z A1 still say 'merged PR'; the gate stops at a reviewed, CI-verified PR
description:
ticfac's hand-over rule changed on 2026-09-18: the factory creates PRs and a person merges. SPEC 12's Phase 4 wording and w1z's acceptance item A1 still describe the gate as a MERGED PR.

Left as-is, the two repositories disagree about what 'done' means for an epic, and the ticfac side is the one that changed deliberately.

Reported by ticfac run epic-ncv, tick pxc, finding fe42c57a.
acceptance_criteria: SPEC 12 Phase 4 and w1z A1 describe the gate as a reviewed, CI-verified PR that a person merges
